Geometry and placement

Destination order is expected to be three cash cards followed by No Fiscales, Fiscales, and Por cobrar. Desktop cards must share dimensions; mobile widths and non-overlap are checked while preserving approved mobile height differences. Ventas is expected to be three equal-width full-row cards with the original content and typography. Por cobrar moves sections but retains exact value, subtitle, dashed border, and canonical href.
